description: Natural Gas Underground Storage in Colorado 2014 is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Information about the Natural Gas Underground Storage resources generated for Colorado Counties by the US Energy Information Administration (USEIA) and updated annually. Navigate to source for most current information. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Energy. Its tags are useia, natural gas, gas storage, fossil fuels, county. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: CEO. The portal shows 2015-02-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
